details: On September 29, 2026, the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) increased its cash rate by 25 basis points to 4.60%, marking its highest level since 2011. This move, the fourth rate hike in 2026, was driven by concerns over persistent inflation, fueled by global oil supply disruptions and strong demand from artificial intelligence investments. RBA Governor Michele Bullock indicated that further rate increases might be necessary to bring inflation back to its target range.
title: RBA Raises Cash Rate to 4.60%, Signals Further Hikes

details: Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook stated on September 28, 2026, that inflation in the US has remained "too high for too long" and is expected to continue rising in the coming months. She attributed these pressures to robust demand stemming from artificial intelligence advancements, increasing oil prices, and geopolitical conflicts in the Middle East. Cook also noted the labor market's resilience, suggesting it could absorb further interest rate adjustments, reinforcing a hawkish stance from the Fed to control price growth.
title: Fed's Cook: Inflation to Persist, Driven by AI & Oil Prices

details: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has called upon Ghana to finalize comprehensive regulations for its burgeoning cryptocurrency market by December 2026. The IMF highlighted shortcomings in the current oversight framework and recommended developing specific, activity-based guidelines for crypto trading, brokerage services, and lending. This initiative aims to bolster consumer protection, maintain market integrity, and ensure financial stability within Ghana's dynamic cryptocurrency sector, which is one of the largest in sub-Saharan Africa.
title: IMF Pushes Ghana for Comprehensive Crypto Regulations by Dec 2026

details: The European Central Bank (ECB) is set to launch workshops in 2027 to explore and test AI-enabled digital euro payments and machine-to-machine interactions. This initiative is part of the ECB's ongoing research into a potential digital euro, with participants developing prototypes for various functionalities, including e-receipts and conditional payments, while prioritizing privacy-by-design principles. The ECB aims for a possible digital euro issuance by 2029, contingent on the adoption of relevant EU legislation.
title: ECB to Test AI-Powered Digital Euro Payments in 2027

details: The August Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index, the Federal Reserve's preferred inflation gauge, registered lower than expected at 0.3% monthly for headline and 0.2% for core inflation. This softer-than-anticipated data significantly decreased the market's expectations for an October Fed rate hike, with the odds dropping to 37% according to the CME FedWatch Tool. A New York Fed official also indicated that possibly only one more rate hike might be necessary this year, suggesting a potential easing of the monetary tightening cycle. Bitcoin saw a 2.31% increase on the news.
title: US PCE Inflation Below Estimates, October Fed Hike Bets Fall
